entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf elf hunter, former commander of the Hemlock pack, who is banished after a massacre and helps defeat Oona; he later dies by moonglove at the hand he promised to use on Maralen.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The plane with two conflicting halves, Lorwyn and Shadowmoor, that alternate under the Great Aurora.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: The elvish fiefdom that prizes beauty, cunning and duty and banishes Rhys.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: A red yew treefolk sage who taught Rhys yew magic and engineers his own rebirth through a seedling.

entities.name: Taercenn Nath
entities.description: Rhys' superior, a Gilt-Leaf taercenn who orders the massacre of boggarts and is killed by Rhys.

entities.name: Gryffid
entities.description: Rhys' friend who takes command of the Hemlock pack and later brands him a traitor.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: An elf of the Mornsong tribe who glamers Rhys, helps kill Oona, and becomes queen of the fae.

entities.name: Oona
aliases: queen and mother of all faeries
entities.description: The faerie queen who controlled the Great Aurora and was defeated, her consciousness hidden and recovering.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Maralen's distant older brother, who manipulates Rhys into striking Maralen.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: A female flamekin who carries a message from Colfenor and is later rekindled by a greater elemental.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: A kithkin archer manipulated by Colfenor.

entities.name: Sygg
entities.description: A merrow ferryman who brings the party to the Murmuring Bosk.

entities.name: Vendilion clique
entities.description: A trio of fae who accompany the party.

entities.name: Murmuring Bosk
entities.description: A sacred treefolk grove destroyed, where Rhys plants Colfenor's seedcone.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: The place where Colfenor waits for Rhys and where Nath is killed and Colfenor burns.

entities.name: Porringer Valley
entities.description: The valley where Nath ordered an attack on a boggart gathering.

entities.name: Feast of Footbottom
entities.description: A peaceful boggart festival and cultural exchange that Nath orders attacked.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: The event, controlled by Oona, that transformed Lorwyn into Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Auntie Thumb
entities.description: A pacifist boggart matron at the Feast of Footbottom.

entities.name: Yelm
entities.description: A young archer who ruined Rhys' ambush and was killed by Nath.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: Shadowmoor's incarnation, roused by Oko.

entities.name: Eirdu
entities.description: Lorwyn's incarnation, who offsets Isilu's darkness.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: The fae location where Rhys lived in Maralen's residence.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: The meadow where Rhys strikes Maralen with moonglove.

events.summary: Rhys is demoted after his ambush on a boggart party fails, and Gryffid takes command of the Hemlock pack.
events.quote: command of the Hemlock pack was handed over to his friend Gryffid

events.summary: Nath orders an attack on the Feast of Footbottom despite Rhys' report that it is a peaceful festival.
events.quote: Nath, with a cold smile, ordered to attack anyway

events.summary: Overwhelmed by feral boggarts, Rhys invokes Colfenor's magic, causing a poison blast that kills everyone except himself, Gryffid and Nath.
events.quote: the result was a ruinous blast of poison that eradicated the forest and killed everyone except Rhys, Gryffid, and Nath

events.summary: Rhys meets Maralen, realizes the blast destroyed his horns, and lets her glamer him.
events.quote: Begrudgingly, Rhys allowed Maralen to bestow a glamer upon him that concealed his disfigurement.

events.summary: Rhys is branded kin-slayer, traitor and outlaw by Nath and Gryffid.
events.quote: he was soon to be branded "kin-slayer", traitor, and outlaw by Nath and Gryffid

events.summary: Ashling, Brigid and the Vendilion clique find Rhys with a message from Colfenor.
events.quote: the flamekin carried a message for him

events.summary: Colfenor declares Rhys his final pupil and asks him to plant his seed cone in the Murmuring Bosk.
events.quote: wishing for him to travel to the Murmuring Bosk and plant his seed cone there

events.summary: Rhys finds the Bosk destroyed and plants the seedcone with an ancient blessing.
events.quote: Rhys planted the seedcone with a solemn reverence

events.summary: Brigid, manipulated by Colfenor, lies about Ashling and Sygg and escapes to Kinsbaile with Ashling.
events.quote: Brigid, who was manipulated into the act by Colfenor, escaped to Kinsbaile with Ashling.

events.summary: Nath and Gryffid ambush the party at Kinsbaile and Nath challenges Rhys to a duel.
events.quote: Nath offered him a sword and challenged him to a duel

events.summary: Rhys kills Nath by twisting his head by the horns until his neck snaps; the elves let him depart.
events.quote: Rhys grabbed Nath by his horns and twisted his head until his neck snapped

events.summary: Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental and Colfenor burns to death as planned, promising to see Rhys again.
events.quote: the rekindling of Ashling by a greater elemental that she was seeking and the fiery demise of Colfenor

events.summary: A young treefolk rises at the Bosk a day after Colfenor's death.
events.quote: greeting them in the name of her seedfather

events.summary: Oona is defeated by Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor's sapling, though her consciousness survives.
events.quote: Though Oona was defeated and her body was destroyed, her consciousness remains hidden

events.summary: Maralen gives Rhys a moonglove flower to use on her if Oona returns through her, and Rhys becomes unable to die until then.
events.quote: until that day came, Rhys could never die

events.summary: Oko manipulates Rhys into believing Maralen is becoming Oona, and Rhys moves to strike her.
events.quote: He brandished his moonglow-tipped dagger against Maralen, but she escaped.

events.summary: Rhys strikes Maralen with moonglove; Oko admits he roused Isilu and turned Rhys against her.
events.quote: Rhys struck her with the moonglove poison, ensuring her death

events.summary: Oko cures Maralen with dawnglow; Eirdu appears to offset Isilu and Rhys is at peace.
events.quote: Oko acquired a vial of dawnglow

events.summary: Rhys declines a new oath, bids Maralen farewell, and fades into a shower of petals.
events.quote: his form faded beautifully into the wind as a shower of petals from across Lorwyn and Shadowmoor

relations.quote: he ended up as an apprentice of the red yew sage Colfenor

relations.note: broke his neck in a duel
relations.quote: Rhys grabbed Nath by his horns and twisted his head until his neck snapped
He was a former commander of the Hemlock pack of hunters who found himself humbled by his own actions and subsequently banished from his tribe.

relations.note: companion who defeated Oona with him

relations.quote: vengefully striking against his mother, Oona
